Priya Rao: Heads-up — candidate (Anika S.) for SRE IC3 interview tomorrow 3pm PST. One panelist (Jamal) flagged a conflict; need swap and remote room link. Can someone take Jamal's slot or confirm backup?
Jamal Chen: Sorry — had to block for a customer call that landed. I can be available at 4pm PST if we push, but otherwise I need a swap. @Avery can you check backups?
Avery Lee: On it. Checking the interviewer pool now. Marta, you ok to cover systems design at 3?
Marta Lopez: I can cover the systems design portion (30m) but prefer to split with Jamal on the postmortem question set. I'm good with 3pm.
Priya Rao: Thanks Marta! That leaves a gap for the earlier culture/behavioral 15m. Any volunteers? Otherwise we can shorten the buffer.
Jamal Chen: If Marta takes systems design, I can still join for the last 20m remotely (love to stay on the loop). Otherwise happy to hand off fully.
Avery Lee: Quick rubric note — for this role let's weight System Design 50, Reliability 30, Collaboration 20. Is everyone aligned? That will help debrief scoring.
Marta Lopez: Ok on weights. One rubric clarification: for Reliability we should include on-call incident handling examples (ask about a time they mitigated a live outage). I'll call that out in my questions.
Priya Rao: Good call. Adding to interview doc: ``Reliability: ask about live incident, rollback strategy, blameless postmortem``
people-ops-bot: Calendar update: new interview room created -> https://cal.company/room/zoom-ops-13 ; invite sent to panel. :white_check_mark:
Avery Lee: Zoom link looks good. Priya — can you update the candidate packet to reflect who is covering culture and who covers collaboration? I can update the rubric page after that.
Priya Rao: Done — I updated the doc and pasted the section below.
Priya Rao: ``Panel plan: 3:00-3:15 Culture (Priya), 3:15-3:45 Systems Design (Marta), 3:45-4:00 Reliability & On-call (Jamal/Marta)``
Jamal Chen: Perfect. I'll join by phone for the last segment in case the earlier call runs over.
Marta Lopez: Also — recording consent? Candidate okayed recording per intake form yes/no?
Priya Rao: Yes — candidate consented in ATS. I'll add a quick verbal consent at start.
Avery Lee: One last quick ask: please capture one example question per rubric bucket in the shared doc so post-interview scoring is faster.
Priya Rao: Will do. Thanks everyone :rocket:
Marta Lopez: :thumbsup:
people-ops-bot: Reminder scheduled -> 30m before interview, room link pinned in calendar.
